transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer care, my name is Hannah. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Hannah. I am really stressed out. I just bought a brand new Samsung Galaxy S24 and tried to transfer my S-Net eSIM from my old phone, but every time I scan the QR activation code from your email, it pops up saying 'eSIM profile invalid or already consumed'! I have an early morning business flight tomorrow and I can't be without a working phone!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can look at your eSIM profile records on our mobile gateway. First can you confirm your full name and billing address for account security?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Keira Walsh, 78 Park Road, Newcastle, NE4 9QH.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Keira. I can hear how stressful this is with your business flight tomorrow, especially when you've just unboxed a new phone. Let me clear that voucher lock so your eSIM connects right now. Can you also confirm the security PIN on the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What exact error code appears on the Samsung screen when you scan the QR code?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It displays 'Error 06: Profile activation code invalid or already used by another device.'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And is your old mobile phone still powered on with the old eSIM active?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the old phone is sitting right here on my desk with one bar of signal.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That explains the conflict. An eSIM profile is cryptographically tied to a single physical EID chip. When you scanned the new QR code, the network register saw that the old profile had not been detached, so it locked the voucher for security.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I thought scanning the new QR code would automatically switch it over!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously telecom cryptographic security prevents unauthorized profile transfers to safeguard mobile banking authentication.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That makes sense, but how do we unblock it now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will take direct ownership of this. I have administrative access to the eSIM wholesale provisioning engine, and I can purge the locked voucher and issue a fresh 32-digit activation token.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do I need to turn off the old phone first?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, please power down the old phone completely now so its radio chip stops transmitting.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Powering down the old phone... It's completely shut off.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now on your new Samsung Galaxy S24, what is the thirty-two digit EID number shown under Settings -> About Phone -> Status Information?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The EID starts with 890490 and ends in 4429.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for forty seconds while I bind that EID to a fresh eSIM profile on our HLR switch.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Keira. The new eSIM profile has been assigned to your EID.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do I scan a new QR code or type it in?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Rather than waiting for an email QR code, we can enter the direct SM-DP+ carrier address and activation code directly into your phone settings.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm ready in the settings menu.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: While we are on your Samsung settings, make sure 'Data Roaming' is toggled to on before you travel to Germany tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Where is the Data Roaming toggle located in Samsung One UI?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Go to Settings -> Connections -> Mobile Networks, and switch 'Data Roaming' to On.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Switched Data Roaming to On.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: European roaming is included at no extra charge on your S-Net contract, so your standard UK data allowance will work seamlessly in Frankfurt.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's wonderful, no need to buy a local airport SIM card.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: On your Samsung S24, go to Settings -> Connections -> SIM Manager.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you can keep your old phone powered off as a backup handset.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Connections... SIM Manager... Got it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Tap 'Add eSIM', then tap 'Scan QR code from service provider', then tap 'Enter activation code' at the bottom.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapped Enter activation code. A text box appeared.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The SM-DP+ server address is: smdp dot s-net dot co dot uk.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Typed smdp dot s-net dot co dot uk.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And the activation code is: SNET-4821-EID9.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Typed SNET-4821-EID9. Tapping Connect now...

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: A pop-up says 'Add S-Net eSIM plan? Your phone number will be 07700 900582'. Tapping Add!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It will take about thirty seconds to download the carrier profile certificate.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Progress bar moving... 'eSIM profile installed successfully'! And the S-Net 5G icon just lit up in the top bar with five full signal bars!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm the error code you saw earlier is completely gone, that was Error 06, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, Error 06 is completely gone, the mobile plan is active and selected as Primary!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let's test making a test call. Dial 123 to verify voice audio.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Dialing 123... Connected instantly, loud and clear automated voice!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And can you turn off Wi-Fi briefly to confirm mobile 5G internet browsing works?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Turned off Wi-Fi... Opening BBC News... Loaded in a split second over 5G!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms full voice, SMS, and high-speed data are operating on your new Samsung S24.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You have completely saved my trip tomorrow Hannah. I was so stressed about landing in Frankfurt with a dead phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm your billing email on file, it's keira dot walsh at tyne dot co dot uk, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's my email.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will leave notes on your account confirming the successful eSIM hardware migration.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Hannah, you've been fantastic.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your new Samsung or your plan that I can help with today, Keira?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Hannah, everything is working flawlessly. Thank you so much.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Keira, and have a safe and successful flight tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Hannah, goodbye.
